events.action-failed: Exact observed error, known-started/known-returned state, saved or partial files and no implicit retry.
events.action-returned: Set immediate in-memory known-completed state and exact success/rejection/result hashes before any fallible journal/evidence operation, then append record. Expected and actual diagnostic are separate.
events.attempt-intended: Write+flush before invoking action. details records exact callable name/input identity or reproducible construction/patch, planned output identity and current counters. No action begins after a failed intention write.
events.save-intended: Before file creation reserve complete count/bytes and record expected path/size/hash; exclusive file write only.
events.saved: After successful bounded write/flush/close/readback record actual complete path/size/hash; writing this journal event may itself fail and must mark persistence uncertain.
events.stopped: Terminal in-memory counts, first failure, planned-unstarted count, incomplete operations and custody status; absence is not success.

journal.failure_policy: If journal/evidence write fails after action return, retain known-returned state in memory, attempt bounded stderr/final report, halt. If durable report cannot be written, existing intent without matching terminal is explicitly uncertain to supervisor; never infer success or fewer actions. No child process launch inside suite.

evidence_schema.mutation_rule: All offsets are into specified predecessor bytes; ordered reconstruction updates offsets deterministically. Each exact_match_count=1; before/after full hash and length validated. JSON patches preserve exact types and canonical encoding; source/output/manifest hash refreshes themselves are explicit patches. No name/hash-only mutant receipt.
notes: All fields and nested schemas require exact source-review freeze before execution. This is a design, not a report that any call has run.
Resource/metadata snapshots from repeated lower calls may be full-byte compared and linked to the exact retained equal string. Do not claim all internal checker calls were individually persisted.
Complete checkout manifest and supervisor records are external to this subset and consume the stated reserve. No hidden ZIP members or cleanup to evade total evidence cap.

script_interface.imports: verified resource-native parent of script only; no old test modules
script_interface.output_parent: supervisor creates fresh outer root only; child evidence root absent
script_interface.removed_environment: PYTHONPATH and all inherited credential/network/proxy settings
